score.note: Page-1 sibling of BattleEffect_FinishHeavyImpact (battle_owner_21.c's Func_080955b0 dispatch table): same source object lookup, WaitFrames/Audio_PlayCue/Func_080925cc opening beats, and the same base+0x58/count=23 EffectSlot spawn tail and NormalizeVector call, all byte-identical in the candidate. The reference additionally spawns 8 child objects in a do-while(count=7) loop via Func_080090c8 (a type read through a two-level pointer chase at ctx+80/+40), links them through Func_08096c48 into an accumulator, then advances ctx's y by 0x80000 for 15 frames, destroys ctx and all 8 children, and conditionally calls Func_08003f3c before the tail. Most of that shape is expressed and byte-matches; the residual concentrates in two spots: (1) the compiler spills the ctx/child pointer walk to sp+20 and keeps a second live copy in fp for reuse by the final destroy loop, where the candidate instead recomputes the array address each time (costs ~20 halfwords across two hunks and the resulting frame-size/offset cascade, sp+48 vs sp+52); (2) a call the reference makes between Func_08009240(child,9) and Func_080091e0(child,0) -- almost certainly Object_SetMode(child,0) given the shared bl target address with the later Object_SetMode(Object_GetById(...),28) call -- could not be reproduced without a much larger regression (adding the call as a plain statement pushed differing_halfwords from 89 to ~190 by disturbing the loop's r8/sl register scheduling); it is left out and recorded as a rejected experiment. All literal pool addresses (0x03001f30, 0x00204084, 0x08096575, 0x02000240, 0x0809641d) and every constant (240, 0xF000, offsets 6/24/28/35/85/90/104/108) are confirmed exact against the disassembly.
